insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 76 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 48 (+3).

insights.statement: Dallas-based Envy Gaming retires esports brand, became Optic on 2022-06-27; no IPO coverage is present in the loaded news subset.
insights.implication: Their timing coincides with increased visibility in the loaded news and Crunchbase momentum signals, but the data does not establish causation.
